تمتزجين (form VIII)
# تَمْتَزِجِينَ (tamtazijīna) /tam.ta.zi.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# تُمْتَزَجِينَ (tumtazajīna) /tum.ta.za.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
